info.what: An ordered, durable log of events that many readers can process, and replay, at their own pace.
info.why: Suits high volumes of events (clicks, payments, sensor readings) that several systems need to handle, now or later.
info.analogy: A recorded TV channel you can rewind.

samples.caption: An append-only log: events keep their order and are never removed on read
Each reader keeps its own place in the log
A reader picks up where it left off and saves its place
